notes_for_editor: NHLR is the main source for the 1939 build, the CCC help, the secondary-lookout purpose and the 2021 registration. Current use and public access are not stated in any source read: the NPS trail page covers the hike only, so the access level is left out of facts. Staffing is not documented; the slide-file captions only label the structure as a lookout (1964) and a lookout station (1975). Unread leads, from search snippets only and not used: a Parkwolf trail page calls the summit lookout 'historic (typically closed)', and a SummitPost Cascade Lake page says an old summit structure is 'apparently no longer in use'. Both should be checked before any statement about current use. Elevation 9,402 ft matches the record's elevation_m 2865.7. No height_m in any source read. No photos added: the NHLR photos lack licence terms and the NPS slide-file image URLs were not captured.
